decision.reason: No compatible cross-target scalar-versus-vector evidence covers the policy scope of VECTOR_IF_ELIGIBLE. The attempted machine-local comparison was invalidated and removed.

source.sourceTreeDefinition: Git tree formed from baseRevision with only production composition, benchmark build configuration, and benchmark Java source replaced by the sealed executable-source.patch content

reasons: 81 of 420 scalar/vector repeated batches were below the claimed 25 ms floor
all scalar processes preceded all vector processes, confounding the comparison with time and thermal drift
within-fork samples were pooled as independent observations instead of treating JVM forks as the independent units
reports omitted source, command, CPU, species, and selected-plan identities
the measured matrix did not cover the broad VECTOR_IF_ELIGIBLE policy

currentBaseline.purpose: Validate the hardened observational protocol against unchanged scalar production; not compare candidates or authorize a route/default change.
currentBaseline.selectedPlanFacts: Unavailable through the public Engine lifecycle. Every report states this limitation and is ineligible for a production decision.

notes: Sealed CPU artifacts are predominantly generated-versus-direct parity, not scalar-versus-vector policy evidence.
Located scalar/vector-related performance records are machine-local macOS AArch64 observations and do not cover the current broad eligible family/type/access matrix.
No compatible x86-64 scalar-versus-vector evidence was found for a universal default.

futureComparisonAcceptanceFramework.minimumPerFamilyRegressionGate: median paired ratio <= 1.05 and sealed upper uncertainty bound <= 1.10
futureComparisonAcceptanceFramework.minimumAggregateImprovementGate: sealed equal-family aggregate median <= 0.95 and sealed upper uncertainty bound <= 1.00
futureComparisonAcceptanceFramework.correctnessGate: all represented output checksums identical before timing
minimumPolicyScope: eligible direct and tiled MATMUL in FLOAT32 and FLOAT64, including contribution-count neighbors around 4,096, 16,384, and 65,536 strategy thresholds
dense MSE NONE in FLOAT32 and FLOAT64 at below-one-lane, exactly-one-lane, one-lane-plus-one, and representative large extents
dense and broadcast pointwise arithmetic in FLOAT32 and FLOAT64
floating transcendental and activation pointwise in FLOAT32 and FLOAT64
BOOL, comparison, mask, and WHERE pointwise
one-node and fused pointwise topologies over dense and eligible contiguous-run access, covering heap-array, segment, and mixed carriers where each is supported
preferred-species lane boundaries at lanes-minus-one, lanes, lanes-plus-one, exact multiples, and masked tails, with ineligible scalar controls
direct Conv2d and Conv3d in FLOAT32 and FLOAT64, covering eligible full-interior blocks plus width-tail, edge, stride, dilation, layout, epilogue, and type fallback controls
futureTaskMustSealBeforeAnyMeasurement: exact CPU model, operating system, HotSpot/JDK build, enabled CPU features, JVM flags, and preferred species for every target stratum
exact operation, topology, data type, shape, layout, access regime, carrier combination, input data, and boundary/fallback control for every workload case
exact randomized interleaved process order and seed for every target stratum
exact family definitions, within-pair aggregation order, family weighting, and cross-family aggregate formula
exact uncertainty algorithm, bootstrap resample count, PRNG and seed expansion, one- or two-sided interval meaning, and quantile convention
exact report schema and verified source/configuration identity
futureComparisonAcceptanceFramework.amendmentRule: Seal these details in a separately reviewed future task before the first warmup or measured execution; do not amend them after observing timing.
